verdict.rationale: Postman's collaboration docs state that roles and permissions can be assigned to team members at the team, workspace, and element levels. Element-level permissions directly cover per-API and per-collection access control, and internal workspaces provide the sharing boundary. However, this rests on a single overview sentence. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of view vs. edit role definitions for APIs and collections, details on how platform engineers configure or audit these permissions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
